item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 01/Nov/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next few days. The weather will be mainly fine and the temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over the region. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China early next week. It will be windier and cloudier over the region.
